_comment: Postcard settings for this scenario (scripts/postcard.py, docs/postcard.md). items: the small pictures shown beside the text; beats: which item each scene (beat) shows. An item is {"file": an existing picture}, {"combine": [{"file", "half": "left"|"right"}, ...]} (halves side by side, made by scripts/postcard_items.py), or {"prompt": ...} (drawn once by scripts/postcard_items.py). anchor (top_right / top_left / bottom_right / bottom_left) and size_mm place it on the card; placement gives the defaults.

gift_box.prompt: A small wrapped present box with a loose blue ribbon bow.

honey_pot.prompt: A round brown ceramic honey pot with golden honey dripping over its rim and a wooden lid resting beside it.

honey_dipper.prompt: A wooden honey dipper with a drop of golden honey hanging from it.

empty_pot.prompt: An empty round brown ceramic honey pot lying on its side, only a thin golden smear inside.

balloon.prompt: A single round red balloon on a curling string.

ribbon_bow.prompt: A single loose satin ribbon bow in soft light blue, two loops and two trailing tails, seen from the front, as if tied on a present.
